mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_tool_onboarding_receipts(tenant_id,request_id,actor_ref,request_fingerprint,owner_id,status,connector_id,tool_names) VALUES(#{tenant},CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid),#{actor},#{fingerprint},CAST(#{owner} AS uuid),'PROCESSING',#{connectorId},CAST(#{toolNames} AS jsonb)) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,request_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_tool_onboarding_receipts SET status=#{status}, response=CAST(#{response} AS jsonb), completed_at=now() WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND request_id=CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid) AND owner_id=CAST(#{owner} AS uuid) AND status='PROCESSING'
mapper.select: SELECT actor_ref, request_fingerprint AS fingerprint, status, connector_id, tool_names::text AS tool_names_json, response::text AS response_json FROM nw_tool_onboarding_receipts WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND request_id=CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid)
